name: fin_efficiency_and_wall_factors
title: Circular-fin efficiency and wall correction factors for Nu and frictional dP (function library)
summary: Three EES FUNCTIONs from the ht library core: the Kern-Kraus closed-form efficiency of a circular fin of constant thickness on a circular tube (modified Bessel functions evaluated by their 13-term power series, exact to machine precision for m*r_e <= 2, since CoolSolve has no Bessel function), and the Kays-Crawford wall correction factors (mu/mu_wall)^n multiplying the Nusselt number or the friction factor / frictional pressure drop, with exponents by flow regime and phase and the heating/cooling direction detected from mu vs mu_wall.

authors: D. Q. Kern and A. D. Kraus (circular-fin efficiency)
W. M. Kays and M. E. Crawford (wall correction factors)
origin.notes: ht 1.2.0, commit 85e0ee6 (2025-12-07), file ht/core.py, MIT license, Copyright (C) 2016 Caleb Bell. The scientific basis of each function is the original book cited in its comment block (Kern & Kraus 1972; Kays & Crawford 1993). Translation published under the CoolSolve_Library MIT license (decision D3). The Bessel functions of the fin formula are evaluated by their 13-term power series (Abramowitz & Stegun), the approach of CSL-0090 and CSL-0099.

verification.reference: doctest values of ht 1.2.0 ht/core.py (case A) and additional values computed with the same ht functions (case B, installed from the local clone, core.py identical to commit 85e0ee6); 26 output values in total
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 26 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); largest relative deviation 4.0e-12 (wall_factor_fd_A_LG), i.e. the print precision of the .sol baseline.
